_about: Deck graphics made with Sprite Fusion (spritefusion.com). source/ holds the image as generated; the graphic is source/ fitted to 32x8 with tools/fit_deck_graphic.gd.

steps.prompt: Underside of a skateboard deck seen from directly below, lying horizontally and filling the full width of the image, bold orange and yellow flames graphic running from nose to tail on a black deck, plain transparent background
Remove the trucks and wheels completely so only the flat deck underside remains; continue the flames graphic where the trucks were; keep the deck shape, outline, size and position exactly the same

Underside of a skateboard deck seen from directly below, lying horizontally and filling the full width of the image, bold blue and white ocean wave graphic running from nose to tail on a teal deck, plain transparent background

Remove the trucks and wheels completely so only the flat deck underside remains; redraw the blue and white ocean wave graphic so it runs along the whole deck from nose to tail and stays inside the deck outline, nothing outside the deck; keep the deck shape, outline, size and position exactly the same
